interpretations: For each site access status, report the status, the unrounded average of site-level mean RAM usage, and the unrounded average of site-level mean `procgpu / proccpu`; include only processing runs with `memusagegb ≥ 60.8` whose `zoneref` matches a site, and ignore missing values in each average.
queries:
WITH site_means AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(p.memusagegb) AS mean_ram,
    AVG(1.0 * p.procgpu / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS mean_gpu_cpu_ratio
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanprocessing AS p
    ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
)
SELECT
  entrystat,
  AVG(mean_ram) AS avg_site_mean_ram,
  AVG(mean_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_site_mean_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM site_means
GROUP BY entrystat
